_reference_frame: Lab-friendly inputs: table surface = vertical reference, screen-centre vertical line = horizontal reference (+ = participant's right when facing the screen), screen front face = distance reference. The loader converts these to PyEtSimul's screen-centre (x, y, z): x = horizontal_from_screen_center_mm (already signed); y = distance_from_screen_mm; z = height_above_table_mm - screen.centre_above_table_mm.

participant_default._note_eye_to_screen: top/bottom are straight-line distances from the eye to those screen edges (encode screen tilt; consumed by pyelink). The per-eye distance_from_screen_mm below is the perpendicular distance (eye to screen plane) used by PyEtSimul. Within ~5 mm tolerance for this lab.

camera._note: Overrides pyelink's hardcoded remote_camera_position. The recording script sends `remote_camera_position = -10 17 <hx_cm> <hz_cm> -<distance_cm>` where hx/hz are this camera's position in cm. Units in the SR Research command are centimetres.

illuminator._note: Documentation only — the illuminator position is fixed by the EyeLink camera bar; pyelink does not configure it. Used by PyEtSimul as the light source position.

cam1.role: matched to the EyeLink 1000 Plus IR camera position; same axes as the EyeLink camera frame.

cam2.role: head-on, eye-height, centred laterally between the two eyes; axes aligned with the participant's eyes.
